strings.#30:
STARRY NIGHT (tm)

Original concept by Jack Eastman.
Lightning designed by Jim Stewart.

You can change the number of buildings and height of the skyline to look like any city you like.

The number of buildings can be varied from 0 to 100 and the skyline can be varied from 5% to 90% of the monitor's height.

You can set the lightning to occur all the time, or never, or somewhere in between.  Seeing lightning, stars, & meteor showers at the same time is rare, but strange things CAN happen 'after dark'.
strings.#14:
Randomizer by Bill Stewart.
  ©1990 Berkeley Systems Inc.
strings.#34:
RANDOMIZER (tm)

Based on original concept by Patrick Beard.

Randomizer lets you select any number of modules and have them displayed in random or sequential order.

Use the "Choose.." button to select the modules to be randomized.  Click on module names in the list to select or deselect them from Randomizer.

The duration for the selected modules can 
be varied from short (1 frame) to 1 module (a different module each time After Dark engages).

If you check the "Clear Screen" check box, the screen is blanked between each module.
